To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the creative potential of space users can be stimulated by means of the following spatial properties: a sense of freedom, spatial variety, a sense of mystery, spatial diversity, and the sense of the unknown.

creative thinking is stimulated in architectural and urban situations that are characterized by: 1. A high level of spatial complexity; 2. The presence of a variety of spatial forms; 3. A variety of spatial relations;

1) the creative thinking of users can be stimulated by the architectural and urban space, 2) the creative thinking is a process, which can be supported by the spatial forms, which are characterized by specific properties.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of spatial properties of architectural and urban situations that stimulate creative thinking.
the identification of spatial properties, which stimulate the process of creative thinking.
the spatial aspects of the creative process and the ways in which the creative process can influence the spatial design of architecture and urban space.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the spatial forms, which stimulate creative thinking, are the forms that are not too complex and not too simple.

there is no single type of space, which stimulates creative thinking in a universal manner, and the most effective spaces are those, which are adapted to the needs of the users and the nature of their creative work.
the creative process is a complex and multi-faceted phenomenon, which can be stimulated by the spatial environment, and which can be researched by means of visual data and questionnaire analysis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
creative spaces are those, which are able to stimulate the creative process of the users by providing them with a set of spatial features.
we are not able to create a new space, which will stimulate creative thinking, but we can design an architectural and urban space, which will be more likely to stimulate creative thinking.
the creative process can occur in any type of space, but it is more likely to occur in spaces that are characterized by the presence of certain spatial features.
The main takeaway from our work is that

there exists a relationship between spatial properties of architectural and urban spaces and creative thinking, which can be researched with a set of innovative research tools, which are visual data analysis and survey.
it is possible to create spatial situations, which stimulate creative thinking.
the spatial properties of architectural and urban environments can be a factor stimulating creative thinking.
